paragraphs.en: LLM-based agents solve complex multi-step tasks, but sequential execution incurs substantial latency. In principle, parallelizing work across multiple agents should yield near-linear speedups. Yet existing parallel multi-agent systems often run slower than a single-agent baseline. We attribute this gap to two hidden costs that parallel execution incurs but a serial agent avoids. First, there is a re-exploration cost : redundant effort spent by parallel workers reconstructing context that the orchestrator already possesses, such as prior decisions, that would otherwise be inherited implicitly in a serial execution. Second, there is an alignment cost : the overhead required to reconcile inconsistencies across independently generated outputs. We thus derive a principled decision criterion: a layer should be parallelized only when its critical-path cost, plus re-exploration and alignment overheads, is lower than the corresponding serial cost. While this criterion is naturally expressed in wall-clock time, we observe that LLMs are poorly calibrated when asked to estimate task duration. To address this, we instead measure cost in predicted output tokens, which we empirically find LLMs can estimate substantially more reliably than wall-clock time. Building on this token-based criterion, we propose SquidAgent. It estimates all token budgets in a single planning step, forks each worker directly from the orchestrator’s session to eliminate re-exploration cost, and replaces post-hoc reconciliation with a pre-generated shared convention block that converts alignment into a bounded upfront cost. A deterministic scheduler then applies the criterion layer by layer. Empirically, SquidAgent achieves a 2.2 × \times mean throughput improvement and a 2.6 × \times mean wall-time speedup over Claude Code, and a 2.0 × \times throughput improvement over the strongest multi-agent baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体能够解决复杂的多步骤任务，但顺序执行会产生显著的延迟。 从原则上讲，将工作并行分配给多个智能体应该能带来接近线性的加速效果。 然而，现有的并行多智能体系统通常运行得比单智能体基线更慢。 我们将这一差距归因于并行执行所引入、而串行智能体却能避免的两项隐藏成本。 首先，存在重新探索成本：并行执行者会重复投入努力，重建协调器已经掌握的背景信息（例如先前的决策），而这些信息在串行执行中本应被隐式继承。 其次，存在对齐成本：需要额外开销来协调独立生成的输出之间的一致性差异。 因此，我们推导出了一个基于原则的决策标准：仅当某一层级的关键路径成本加上重新探索和对齐的额外开销低于对应的串行成本时，才应将其并行化。 尽管这一标准天然可以用实际运行时间来表达，但我们观察到，大型语言模型在估算任务持续时间时校准效果不佳。 为了解决这个问题，我们转而以预测的输出词符数量来衡量成本，通过实证我们发现，大型语言模型对此的估算比实际运行时间可靠得多。 基于这一词符导向的标准，我们提出了 SquidAgent。 它能在单次规划步骤中估算所有词符预算，直接从协调器的会话中分叉每个执行者以消除重新探索成本，并用预先生成的共享约定块替代事后的协调过程，从而将对齐问题转化为一个有上限的初始成本。 随后，一个确定性调度器会逐层应用这一标准。 实证表明，与 Claude Code 相比，SquidAgent 的平均吞吐量提升了 2.2 倍（2.2 ×），平均实际运行时间加速了 2.6 倍（2.6 ×）；与最强的多智能体基线相比，其吞吐量提升了 2.0 倍（2.0 ×）。

paragraphs.en: LLM-based agent systems are increasingly deployed for complex, multi-step tasks such as software development ( Hong et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2024 ) , document authoring, and structured planning. As tasks grow in scale and complexity, a single agent often becomes a bottleneck, motivating the rise of multi-agent systems that coordinate multiple specialized agents to solve a task collaboratively. A common paradigm in these systems is to decompose a high-level user request into a set of subtasks organized as a directed acyclic graph (DAG) ( Zhuge et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2025 ) , where edges encode dependencies between subtasks, and assign each subtask to a dedicated agent. This graph-based decomposition has been adopted by a wide range of multi-agent frameworks, from general-purpose conversation platforms ( Wu et al., 2024a ; Li et al., 2023 ) to specialized systems for code generation ( Niu et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2024 ) and workflow automation ( Zhuge et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024b ) . In this work, we focus on the common LLM-agent setting in which an orchestrator delegates subtasks to multiple LLM workers that share the objective of completing the user request.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体系统正越来越多地部署于复杂的多步骤任务中，例如软件开发（Hong et al., 2024；Qian et al., 2024）、文档撰写和结构化规划。 随着任务的规模和复杂程度不断提升，单个智能体往往会成为瓶颈，这推动了多智能体系统的兴起，这些系统通过协调多个专业智能体来协作完成任务。 这类系统中一种常见的范式是将高层用户请求分解为一系列以有向无环图（DAG）形式组织的子任务（Zhuge et al., 2024；Qian et al., 2025），其中边表示子任务之间的依赖关系，并将每个子任务分配给一个专用智能体。 这种基于图的分解方法已被广泛的多智能体框架所采用，从通用对话平台（Wu et al., 2024a；Li et al., 2023）到专门用于代码生成的系统（Niu et al., 2025；Kim et al., 2024）以及工作流自动化系统（Zhuge et al., 2024；Wu et al., 2024b）。 在本项工作中，我们聚焦于常见的 LLM-智能体设置，即一个协调器将子任务分配给多个 LLM 执行者，这些执行者共享完成用户请求这一共同目标。

paragraphs.en: A key advantage of multi-agent systems is the potential for parallelism . When subtasks at the same DAG layer are independent, multiple worker agents can execute them concurrently, so that wall-clock time is determined by the slowest worker rather than the sum of all tasks. This suggests a fundamental limitation in current execution strategies: they lack an explicit criterion for determining when parallelization is actually worthwhile. Existing methods either rely on fixed execution policies, such as always parallelizing subtasks once explicit dependencies are satisfied ( Qian et al., 2025 ; Niu et al., 2025 ) , or depend on heuristic LLM-based scheduling decisions ( Dang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) . paragraphs.en: We argue that the answer depends on accounting for the hidden costs introduced by parallelization. We identify two such costs that parallelism pays but a sequential agent does not. The first is re-exploration cost : any agent, serial or parallel, must do some exploration to understand a task before solving it, but a serial agent does so once and reuses the resulting context for free, whereas parallel workers have to independently rediscover the same conventions, assumptions, and intermediate decisions before they can begin useful work. Note that this is not generic exploration, it is the redundant portion that exists only because the orchestrator’s planning state cannot be transferred to parallel workers for free. The second is alignment cost : independently generated outputs must be reconciled into a coherent final result, and inconsistencies among workers may require additional correction. These costs arise because LLM-generated DAGs typically capture explicit dependencies among subtasks but overlook implicit dependencies, such as shared naming conventions, formatting choices, or global design decisions, that a single agent would resolve incrementally. Parallel execution is therefore beneficial only when the time saved by concurrency outweighs the additional re-exploration and alignment costs. paragraphs.en: In this paper, we instead propose a parallelization criterion that makes this trade-off explicit and computable before execution. For a group of subtasks, the estimated serial cost is the sum of all subtask costs, while the estimated parallel cost consists of the slowest worker’s execution cost together with the re-exploration and alignment costs. Parallel execution is selected only when the estimated parallel cost is strictly lower than the estimated serial cost. The natural unit for this criterion is wall-clock time, which is what users observe. However, predicting wall-clock time at planning time turns out to be unreliable for two reasons. First, it is backend-dependent (server load, batching, retries). Second, and more fundamentally, LLMs are systematically miscalibrated when asked to estimate their own task duration: they anchor on human-engineering norms (“this looks like a few-day task”) rather than on their own throughput, and their estimates exhibit substantial rank reversals relative to realized execution time, so even the relative ordering of task costs can flip between the estimate and reality. We therefore measure cost in predicted output tokens, a quantity an LLM can estimate well because it is a property of its own next response (the size of the artifact it would write) rather than the duration of an agentic process. For a fixed model and decoding configuration, tokens are emitted at an approximately constant rate, providing a backend-independent proxy for time. Unlike fixed or heuristic policies, this token-cost criterion is an explicit, layer-wise decision rule over the task DAG.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们转而提出一种并行化标准，该标准在执行前就能明确体现并计算出这种权衡。 对于一组子任务，预估的串行成本是所有子任务成本的总和，而预估的并行成本则由最慢执行者的执行成本以及重新探索与对齐的成本组成。 只有当预估的并行成本严格低于预估的串行成本时，才会选择并行执行。 这一标准的自然单位是实际运行时间，也就是用户所观察到的时间。 然而，在规划阶段预测实际运行时间因两个原因而变得不可靠。 首先，它依赖于后端系统（服务器负载、批量处理、重试）。 其次，也是更根本的原因，当要求 LLM 估计自身任务时长时，它们会系统性出现校准偏差：它们会锚定在人类工程规范上（“这看起来像是一个需要几天才能完成的任务”），而不是自身的吞吐量；而且它们的预估结果与实际执行时间相比会出现显著的排名反转，因此即使任务成本的相对顺序也可能在预估与现实之间发生颠倒。 因此，我们将成本以预测的输出词元数来衡量，这是一个 LLM 能够良好估计的量，因为它是自身下一个响应的属性（即它将生成的产物大小），而非智能体过程持续时间的体现。 对于固定的模型和解码配置，词元会以近似恒定的速率发出，从而提供了一个不依赖后端系统的时间代理指标。 与固定策略或启发式策略不同，这种基于词元成本的标准是一种针对任务 DAG 的显式、逐层决策规则。

sents.en: In this paper, we instead propose a parallelization criterion that makes this trade-off explicit and computable before execution.
sents.zh: 在本文中，我们转而提出一种并行化标准，该标准在执行前就能明确体现并计算出这种权衡。

sents.en: For a group of subtasks, the estimated serial cost is the sum of all subtask costs, while the estimated parallel cost consists of the slowest worker’s execution cost together with the re-exploration and alignment costs.
sents.zh: 对于一组子任务，预估的串行成本是所有子任务成本的总和，而预估的并行成本则由最慢执行者的执行成本以及重新探索与对齐的成本组成。

sents.en: Parallel execution is selected only when the estimated parallel cost is strictly lower than the estimated serial cost.
sents.zh: 只有当预估的并行成本严格低于预估的串行成本时，才会选择并行执行。

sents.en: The natural unit for this criterion is wall-clock time, which is what users observe.
sents.zh: 这一标准的自然单位是实际运行时间，也就是用户所观察到的时间。

sents.en: However, predicting wall-clock time at planning time turns out to be unreliable for two reasons.
sents.zh: 然而，在规划阶段预测实际运行时间因两个原因而变得不可靠。

sents.en: First, it is backend-dependent (server load, batching, retries).
sents.zh: 首先，它依赖于后端系统（服务器负载、批量处理、重试）。

sents.en: Second, and more fundamentally, LLMs are systematically miscalibrated when asked to estimate their own task duration: they anchor on human-engineering norms (“this looks like a few-day task”) rather than on their own throughput, and their estimates exhibit substantial rank reversals relative to realized execution time, so even the relative ordering of task costs can flip between the estimate and reality.
sents.zh: 其次，也是更根本的原因，当要求 LLM 估计自身任务时长时，它们会系统性出现校准偏差：它们会锚定在人类工程规范上（“这看起来像是一个需要几天才能完成的任务”），而不是自身的吞吐量；而且它们的预估结果与实际执行时间相比会出现显著的排名反转，因此即使任务成本的相对顺序也可能在预估与现实之间发生颠倒。

sents.en: We therefore measure cost in predicted output tokens, a quantity an LLM can estimate well because it is a property of its own next response (the size of the artifact it would write) rather than the duration of an agentic process.
sents.zh: 因此，我们将成本以预测的输出词元数来衡量，这是一个 LLM 能够良好估计的量，因为它是自身下一个响应的属性（即它将生成的产物大小），而非智能体过程持续时间的体现。

sents.en: For a fixed model and decoding configuration, tokens are emitted at an approximately constant rate, providing a backend-independent proxy for time.
sents.zh: 对于固定的模型和解码配置，词元会以近似恒定的速率发出，从而提供了一个不依赖后端系统的时间代理指标。

sents.en: Unlike fixed or heuristic policies, this token-cost criterion is an explicit, layer-wise decision rule over the task DAG.
sents.zh: 与固定策略或启发式策略不同，这种基于词元成本的标准是一种针对任务 DAG 的显式、逐层决策规则。

paragraphs.en: Based on this criterion, we propose SquidAgent, a cost-aware parallel multi-agent framework that realizes token-cost scheduling in practice. SquidAgent first decomposes a user request into a DAG and, in the same planning response, estimates token budgets for both subtask execution and layer-level alignment cost. It then applies the criterion to each topological layer, choosing parallel execution when the estimated parallel cost is lower than the estimated serial cost, and serial execution otherwise. To further reduce the hidden costs themselves, workers fork the orchestrator’s conversation, inheriting global conventions and prior decisions. This reduces redundant reconstruction of the planning context, motivating the operational approximation C exp ≈ 0 C_{\mathrm{exp}}\approx 0 . The orchestrator also writes a shared convention block before each parallel layer, reducing subsequent inconsistency and making the upfront planning cost estimable. Code is available at: https://github.com/tmllab/2026_NeurIPS_SquidAgent .

paragraphs.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: Hidden-cost analysis of parallel multi-agent execution. We identify two operationally distinct sources of coordination overhead in parallel LLM-agent execution: (i) the re-exploration cost , where parallel workers redundantly reconstruct the orchestrator’s planning context that a serial agent retains implicitly, and (ii) the alignment cost , incurred when independently generated outputs must be reconciled into a globally consistent solution. We show that parallel execution can be counterproductive when these costs outweigh the benefit of concurrency.
paragraphs.zh: 并行多智能体执行的隐藏成本分析。 我们识别出并行 LLM-智能体执行中两种在操作层面截然不同的协调开销来源：(i) 重新探索成本，即并行工作者会冗余地重建协调器所规划的上下文——而串行智能体会以隐式方式保留该上下文；以及 (ii) 对齐成本，即当独立生成的输出必须整合成一个全局一致的方案时所产生的成本。 我们证明，当这些成本超过并发带来的收益时，并行执行可能会适得其反。

paragraphs.en: A token-cost criterion for adaptive parallelization. We observe that wall-clock time is the natural optimization target, but is poorly estimated by LLMs due to systematic miscalibration in predicting task duration. We instead use predicted output tokens as a proxy cost, which LLMs can estimate more reliably than wall-clock time as a property of their own responses and which is backend-independent. Based on this, we formalize parallelization as a cost-sensitive scheduling problem and derive a layer-wise criterion comparing (i) predicted serial cost (sum of subtasks) against (ii) predicted parallel cost (critical path plus re-exploration and alignment costs). The criterion is computed before execution and applied per topological layer of the task DAG.
paragraphs.zh: 一种基于令牌成本的自适应并行化标准。 我们观察到，实际运行时间是自然的优化目标，但由于 LLM 在预测任务时长时存在系统性偏差，导致其对该时间的估计效果不佳。 因此，我们转而使用预测的输出令牌数作为代理成本，因为对于 LLM 而言，这一成本作为其自身响应的属性，比实际运行时间更容易可靠地估计，且不受后端系统的影响。 基于此，我们将并行化形式化为一个成本敏感的调度问题，并推导出一种逐层标准：比较（i）预测的串行成本（子任务之和）与（ii）预测的并行成本（关键路径加上重新探索与对齐成本）。 该标准在执行前进行计算，并应用于任务 DAG 的每个拓扑层。

paragraphs.en: The SquidAgent framework. We instantiate this criterion in SquidAgent, a parallel multi-agent framework for cost-aware execution. Our method (i) estimates token budgets in a single planning pass, (ii) initializes workers from a shared orchestrator state to reduce redundant re-exploration, and (iii) writes a shared convention block to reduce alignment cost across parallel workers. Across all nine evaluation tasks, SquidAgent achieves a 2.6 × \times average wall-time speedup and a 2.2 × \times average throughput improvement over Claude Code. It also achieves a 2.0 × \times average throughput improvement over the strongest multi-agent baseline while obtaining the best overall task completion quality.

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent LLM systems decompose complex tasks into subtasks and solve them through coordinated agents ( Guo et al., 2024 ) . Existing systems differ mainly in how they organize execution. Sequential pipelines, such as MetaGPT ( Hong et al., 2024 ) , SeqCV ( Yao et al., 2025 ) , and OneFlow ( Xu et al., 2026 ) , execute subtasks step by step and preserve global consistency, but they sacrifice parallel speedup. Parallel systems, such as MacNet ( Qian et al., 2025 ) , Flow ( Niu et al., 2025 ) , and LLMCompiler ( Kim et al., 2024 ) , dispatch independent subtasks to concurrent workers, but typically rely on fixed parallelization rules rather than an explicit cost-benefit criterion. Other frameworks, including AutoGen ( Wu et al., 2024a ) , ChatDev ( Qian et al., 2024 ) , CAMEL ( Li et al., 2023 ) , and AgentVerse ( Chen et al., 2024b ) , provide flexible agent composition, but leave the execution policy largely to the developer. Debate-style systems ( Du et al., 2024 ; Liang et al., 2024 ; Chan et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024a ) improve answer quality through iterative critique and consensus, which is orthogonal to our focus on execution scheduling. Consensus Matrix explores role-specialized multi-agent collaboration for structured decision-making in visual media workflows ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Heterogeneous agent collaborative reinforcement learning shares verified rollouts during training while operating independently at inference time ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) . In contrast, we study how multiple workers should be coordinated during inference.

paragraphs.en: Graph-structured reasoning and execution have been widely used to expose dependencies among intermediate steps. Tree-of-Thoughts ( Yao et al., 2023 ) , Graph-of-Thoughts ( Besta et al., 2024 ) , and Skeleton-of-Thought ( Ning et al., 2024 ) structure single-agent reasoning as trees, graphs, or parallel skeleton expansion. In multi-agent settings, GPTSwarm ( Zhuge et al., 2024 ) , AgentKit ( Wu et al., 2024b ) , TDAG ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , and DynTaskMAS ( Yu et al., 2025 ) represent tasks or agents as computational graphs with explicit dependencies. These graph representations naturally induce dependency layers that can serve as synchronization points. Our work uses this layer structure not merely for execution, but as the unit for deciding whether parallelization is worthwhile.
paragraphs.zh: 图结构推理与执行已被广泛用于揭示中间步骤之间的依赖关系。 思维树（Yao 等，2023）、思维图（Besta 等，2024）和思维骨架（Ning 等，2024）将单智能体推理结构化为树、图或平行的骨架扩展形式。 在多智能体场景中，GPTSwarm（Zhuge 等，2024）、AgentKit（Wu 等，2024b）、TDAG（Wang 等，2025）和 DynTaskMAS（Yu 等，2025）将任务或智能体表示为具有显式依赖的计算图。 这些图表示天然会形成依赖层，这些依赖层可用作同步点。 我们的工作不仅利用这种分层结构进行执行，更将其作为判断并行化是否值得的基本单位。

paragraphs.en: Existing systems typically use fixed serial execution, fixed parallel execution, or heuristic adaptive control. Fixed strategies ignore task-dependent coordination costs, while adaptive systems such as the Evolving Orchestrator ( Dang et al., 2026 ) and AgentConductor ( Wang et al., 2026b ) adjust execution strategies without an explicit serial-versus-parallel cost criterion. Adaptive reasoning termination ( Huang et al., 2026d ) reduces computation within individual responses. Related work on token efficiency ( Lin et al., 2026 ) , agent scheduling theory ( Wei, 2026 ) , and workflow optimization ( Yue et al., 2026 ) highlights the importance of reducing agent execution cost, but does not provide an operational decision rule for LLM-agent parallelization. SquidAgent addresses this gap by comparing the estimated serial cost of each dependency layer with its effective parallel cost, including coordination overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 现有系统通常采用固定的串行执行、固定的并行执行或启发式自适应控制。 固定策略会忽略任务相关的协调成本，而像 Evolving Orchestrator（Dang 等人，2026）和 AgentConductor（Wang 等人，2026b）这样的自适应系统则在没有明确的串行与并行成本标准的情况下调整执行策略。 自适应推理终止（Huang 等人，2026d）减少了单个响应内的计算量。 关于标记效率（Lin 等人，2026）、智能体调度理论（Wei，2026）和工作流优化（Yue 等人，2026）的相关研究强调了降低智能体执行成本的重要性，但并未提供用于 LLM-智能体并行化的可操作决策规则。 SquidAgent 通过比较每个依赖层的预估串行成本与其有效并行成本（包括协调开销）来解决这一问题。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we present SquidAgent. We first define the task decomposition setting and notation (Section 3.1 ). We then derive a wall-clock parallelization criterion, explain why it is unreliable to estimate before execution, and introduce a token-cost criterion as a computable alternative (Section 3.2 ). Finally, we describe how SquidAgent implements this criterion through context forking, upfront convention planning, and deterministic layer-wise scheduling (Section 3.3 ).

paragraphs.en: Although Eq. 4 is the desired decision rule, its terms cannot be reliably predicted before execution. Wall-clock time depends on backend conditions such as server load, batching, throttling, retries, and tool-call latency. LLMs are also poorly calibrated when asked to estimate their own execution duration: they tend to answer in human-engineering time rather than model-runtime time. Such estimates may mis-rank subtasks relative to their realized execution times, since human-difficult tasks are not always slow for LLM agents, while long outputs, tool calls, and retries can dominate actual runtime.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管公式 4 是理想的决策规则，但其各项参数在执行前无法可靠预测。 实际运行时间取决于后端条件，例如服务器负载、批量处理、速率限制、重试以及工具调用延迟。 当被要求估算自身执行时长时，大型语言模型（LLM）的估计结果也存在严重偏差：它们倾向于以人类工程时间而非模型运行时时间来作答。 这类估计可能会错误地排序子任务与其实际执行时间的关系，因为对人类而言困难的任务对 LLM 智能体而言并不总是缓慢的，而长输出、工具调用和重试却可能主导实际运行时间。

paragraphs.en: We address this issue by estimating output length rather than execution time. Instead of asking “how long will this task take?”, SquidAgent asks “how many output tokens will this task require?” This quantity is better calibrated because it reflects the size of the artifact the LLM will generate, rather than the duration of an agentic process. For a fixed model and decoding configuration, output tokens are produced at a roughly stable rate, making token count a practical proxy for relative execution time. Moreover, token budgets can be grounded in concrete deliverables, turning estimation into a content-length prediction rather than a runtime prediction. This proxy is primarily suited to LLM-generation-dominated workflows and does not directly capture latency from tool execution, retrieval, or external API calls.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过估算输出长度而非执行时间来应对这个问题。 SquidAgent 没有问“这项任务需要多长时间？”，而是问“这项任务需要多少输出标记？”这一数量更容易校准，因为它反映了 LLM 将生成的产物规模，而非智能体过程的持续时间。 对于固定的模型和解码配置，输出标记的生成速率大致稳定，因此标记数量是相对执行时间的实用替代指标。 此外，标记预算可以基于具体的交付成果来设定，从而将估算转化为对内容长度的预测，而非运行时间的预测。 这种替代指标主要适用于以 LLM 生成为主导的工作流程，无法直接反映工具执行、信息检索或外部 API 调用所带来的延迟。

paragraphs.en: A naive worker must reconstruct the global plan before doing useful work, which introduces duplicated exploration. SquidAgent avoids this by launching each worker from the orchestrator’s session state, so the worker inherits the planning context, conventions, and architectural decisions already established by the orchestrator. It can therefore proceed directly to its assigned subtask rather than rediscovering global context. Context inheritance therefore reduces re-exploration cost to near zero, yielding C exp ​ ( ℒ k ) ≈ 0 C_{\mathrm{exp}}(\mathcal{L}_{k})\approx 0 in Eq. 8 . The component ablation in Section 4.4 evaluates the contribution of this mechanism.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate SquidAgent on 9 evaluation tasks spanning code generation, document authoring, and structured planning, and compare it with 7 baselines. We additionally isolate the three components (Section 4.4 ) and compare token and time prediction (Section 4.5 ). Additional experiments on margin stability across all nine tasks and transfer to external tasks are presented in Appendices F.2 and G , respectively. We describe the experimental setup (Section 4.1 ), report throughput results (Section 4.2 ), evaluate output quality (Section 4.3 ), and analyze the scheduler’s sensitivity to ratio estimation and the margin parameter α \alpha (Section 4.6 ). Layer-wise scheduler decisions are detailed in Appendix C . Visualizations of the results generated by all methods are provided at: https://yexionglin.github.io/SquidAgent_Demo .

paragraphs.en: We design a suite of 9 evaluation tasks spanning code generation, technical writing, and structured planning (Table 5 ; full prompts in Appendix A ). The tasks are designed to expose different coordination challenges faced by multi-agent systems, including independent module parallelism, shared interface constraints, cross-file consistency, long-form generation, and dependencies across modules.
paragraphs.zh: 我们设计了一套包含 9 项评估任务的系统，涵盖代码生成、技术写作和结构化规划（表 5；完整提示词见附录 A）。 这些任务旨在揭示多智能体系统所面临的不同协调挑战，包括独立模块的并行性、共享接口约束、跨文件一致性、长文本生成以及模块间的依赖关系。

paragraphs.en: Heavy tasks contain 8–27 files with 300–900 lines per file: 1) PixelCraft , a Python/Pygame survival game testing parallel implementation of loosely coupled game systems; 2) ShopFlow , a full-stack e-commerce application testing consistency across backend APIs, authentication, admin logic, and frontend pages; 3) CompressKit , a compression toolkit testing shared data-format constraints across multiple algorithms; 4) ArcadeBox , a collection of HTML5 Canvas games testing high parallelism across mostly independent modules; 5) SlideKit , ML workshop slide decks and handouts testing long-form generation with cross-document consistency; 6) ClimateAnalysis , analysis scripts and reports testing consistency between computed results and written summaries.
paragraphs.zh: 复杂任务包含 8–27 个文件，每个文件有 300–900 行代码：1) PixelCraft，一款使用 Python/Pygame 开发的生存游戏，用于测试松耦合游戏系统的并行实现；2) ShopFlow，一个全栈电子商务应用，用于测试后端 API、身份验证、管理员逻辑和前端页面之间的一致性；3) CompressKit，一个压缩工具包，用于测试多种算法之间共享数据格式的一致性；4) ArcadeBox，一系列 HTML5 Canvas 游戏，用于测试大部分独立模块之间的高度并行性；5) SlideKit，机器学习工作坊的幻灯片和讲义，用于测试长文本生成及跨文档一致性；6) ClimateAnalysis，分析脚本和报告，用于测试计算结果与书面摘要之间的一致性。

paragraphs.en: Medium tasks contain 6–10 files with 150–600 lines per file: 7) LinAlgBook , a linear algebra tutorial testing structured mathematical writing; 8) MathRef , a discrete mathematics reference testing tightly coupled cross-references; 9) CloudDocs , API documentation testing consistency between module-level references and cross-cutting guides.
paragraphs.zh: 中等难度的任务包含 6–10 个文件，每个文件有 150–600 行代码：7) LinAlgBook，一个测试结构化数学写作的线性代数教程；8) MathRef，一个测试紧密耦合交叉引用的离散数学参考手册；9) CloudDocs，用于测试模块级引用与跨模块指南之间一致性的 API 文档。

paragraphs.en: We compare SquidAgent with seven representative baselines spanning single-agent execution, sequential verification, role-based workflows, workflow search, parallel execution, and adaptive coordination. Claude Code is a baseline using raw claude -p without additional orchestration instructions. SeqCV ( Yao et al., 2025 ) performs sequential execution with cross-model verification. MetaGPT ( Hong et al., 2024 ) follows a role-based workflow with predefined agents such as product manager, architect, and engineer. AFlow ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) searches over operator pipelines and executes the selected workflow. Flow ( Niu et al., 2025 ) uses git-based orchestration with parallel workers in isolated worktrees. MacNet ( Qian et al., 2025 ) organizes agents in a DAG-style topology with draft-review interactions. AgentConductor ( Wang et al., 2026b ) adaptively adjusts the coordination structure according to task difficulty.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 SquidAgent 与七种具有代表性的基线方法进行了比较，这些方法涵盖了单智能体执行、顺序验证、基于角色的工作流程、工作流程搜索、并行执行和自适应协调。 Claude Code 是一种基线方法，它直接使用 raw claude -p，没有额外的编排指令。 SeqCV（Yao 等人，2025）通过跨模型验证进行顺序执行。 MetaGPT（Hong 等人，2024）遵循基于角色的工作流程，其中包含产品经理、架构师和工程师等预定义的智能体。 AFlow（Zhang 等人，2025）在操作符管道中进行搜索，并执行选定的工作流程。 Flow（Niu 等人，2025）使用基于 git 的编排方式，并在隔离的工作树中部署并行工作者。 MacNet（Qian 等人，2025）将智能体组织成 DAG 风格的拓扑结构，并引入草案与评审的交互机制。 AgentConductor（Wang 等人，2026b）会根据任务难度自适应地调整协调结构。

paragraphs.en: The improvement is most evident on large tasks, where the task structure exposes substantial independent work that can be executed in parallel. For example, SquidAgent improves throughput over the strongest baseline by 2.8 × \times on ArcadeBox and 2.3 × \times on SlideKit. On medium tasks, the absolute gains are smaller because there are fewer independent subtasks to parallelize, but SquidAgent still achieves the best throughput on every task. Overall, SquidAgent increases mean throughput from 17.2 to 38.1 words/s compared with Claude Code, corresponding to a 2.2 × \times speedup, and from 19.2 to 38.1 words/s compared with the strongest multi-agent baseline, AgentConductor, corresponding to a 2.0 × \times speedup. These results show that SquidAgent improves efficiency not merely by increasing parallelism, but by parallelizing only when the estimated serial cost exceeds the effective parallel cost, including coordination overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 这种改进在大型任务中最为明显，因为任务结构暴露出大量可以并行执行的工作。 例如，SquidAgent 在 ArcadeBox 上的吞吐量比最强的基线模型提升了 2.8 × \times，在 SlideKit 上则提升了 2.3 × \times。 在中型任务中，绝对增益较小，因为可以并行处理的独立子任务较少，但 SquidAgent 仍然在所有任务中实现了最高的吞吐量。 总体而言，与 Claude Code 相比，SquidAgent 将平均吞吐量从 17.2 提升至 38.1 词/秒，相当于 2.2 × \times 的速度提升；与最强的多智能体基线模型 AgentConductor 相比，则从 19.2 提升至 38.1 词/秒，相当于 2.0 × \times 的速度提升。 这些结果表明，SquidAgent 提高效率不仅通过增加并行性，更在于仅在预估的串行成本超过有效并行成本（包括协调开销）时进行并行处理。

paragraphs.en: We individually ablate the three components on four tasks, which the orchestrator decomposes into multi-layer DAGs (Table 3 ). Without scheduling parallelizes all eligible multi-task layers. Without session forking removes inherited context. Without convention planning leaves consistency correction to the final review. The other two components remain enabled. All three removals lower throughput; removing scheduling incurs a 32.1% decrease. Their effects are not additive.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在四个任务上分别禁用这三个组件，而协调器则将这些任务分解为多层有向无环图（表 3）。 没有调度机制时，所有符合条件的多任务层都会被并行执行。 没有会话分叉时，继承的上下文会被移除。 没有约定规划时，一致性修正将留待最终审查阶段处理。 另外两个组件仍然处于启用状态。 移除这三个组件中的任何一个都会降低吞吐量；移除调度机制会导致吞吐量下降 32.1%。 它们的影响并非简单叠加。

paragraphs.en: We present SquidAgent, a cost-aware scheduler for multi-agent LLM systems. Parallel execution can introduce re-exploration and alignment costs that offset its speedup when subtasks are tightly coupled. SquidAgent captures this trade-off with a token-cost criterion and decides, for each dependency layer, whether to run serially or in parallel. It further reduces coordination cost through context inheritance and upfront convention planning. Across nine evaluation tasks, SquidAgent improves mean throughput by 2.2 × \times over Claude Code and 2.0 × \times over the strongest multi-agent baseline, while maintaining competitive quality. These results highlight cost-aware scheduling as a practical principle for efficient multi-agent LLM execution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 SquidAgent，这是一种面向多智能体大语言模型系统的成本感知调度器。 当子任务之间耦合紧密时，并行执行可能会引入重新探索和对齐成本，从而抵消其带来的加速效果。 SquidAgent 通过一种令牌成本标准来捕捉这种权衡关系，并为每个依赖层决定是串行执行还是并行执行。 它还通过上下文继承和预先的协议规划进一步降低了协调成本。 在九项评估任务中，SquidAgent 的平均吞吐量比 Claude Code 提升了 2.2 × \times，比最强的多智能体基线模型提升了 2.0 × \times，同时保持了具有竞争力的质量。 这些结果表明，成本感知调度是高效执行多智能体大语言模型的一项实用原则。

paragraphs.en: SquidAgent has three main limitations. First, its fixed safety margin does not adapt to uncertainty in token estimates. Second, its token proxy does not capture tool or API latency. Third, SquidAgent makes a single serial-or-parallel decision for each layer, even when some tasks would benefit from parallel execution while others would be better run serially. Appendix H discusses these limitations and future directions.

paragraphs.en: The scheduler is implemented as a deterministic Python function that is automatically invoked inside the create_plan_branch tool. When the orchestrator calls this tool with a task list, the tool: (1) parses the task DAG from the tasks and layer_convention_tokens fields, (2) runs the scheduler (computing topological layers, applying the token-cost inequality per layer with layer-specific C ^ alg ​ ( ℒ k ) \widehat{C}_{\mathrm{alg}}(\mathcal{L}_{k}) ), and (3) returns the execution schedule as part of the tool response. paragraphs.en: The scheduler relies on the orchestrator LLM to estimate per-task output tokens and per-layer alignment costs. paragraphs.en: Predicted output tokens are a practical proxy mainly for LLM-generation-dominated workflows and do not directly capture latency from tool execution, retrieval, environment interaction, or external API calls. These costs can vary substantially with network conditions, server load, caching, and retries, making them difficult to estimate reliably before execution. Although context inheritance can avoid some duplicated calls by allowing workers to reuse tool and retrieval results obtained during planning, it cannot eliminate task-specific external operations. Future work could incorporate environment-specific latency models or online runtime measurements into the scheduling criterion.
paragraphs.zh: 预测的输出标记主要适用于以 LLM 生成为主导的工作流程，是一种实用的替代指标，但它们并未直接反映工具执行、信息检索、环境交互或外部 API 调用所产生的延迟。 这些成本会因网络状况、服务器负载、缓存机制和重试次数而显著变化，因此在执行前难以可靠地估算。 尽管上下文继承可以通过允许工作单元复用规划阶段获得的工具和检索结果来避免部分重复调用，但它无法消除任务特定的外部操作。 未来的研究可以将特定环境的延迟模型或在线运行时测量数据纳入调度标准中。

paragraphs.en: The cost inequality operates at the DAG layer level: all tasks within a layer receive the same parallel/serial decision. This may miss opportunities when a layer contains a mix of large and small tasks that would benefit from different treatment. The current implementation partially addresses this via a threshold that forces small tasks ( < < 3000 estimated tokens) into serial mode, but a finer-grained per-task decision mechanism could improve efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: 成本不平等性在 DAG 层级别上起作用：同一层内的所有任务都会得到相同的并行/串行决策。 当一个层同时包含大型和小型任务，而这些任务本可以通过不同处理方式获益时，这种做法可能会错失机会。 当前实现通过一个阈值部分解决了这个问题，该阈值会将小型任务（< < 3000 个预估词元）强制进入串行模式，但一种更精细的按任务决策机制或许能提高效率。

paragraphs.en: Future work could extend SquidAgent along three directions. First, adaptive scheduling and dependency modeling could improve decisions as worker capabilities and task relationships change. Cost estimates could be recalibrated during model adaptation [ Huang et al., 2025 , Cai and Sugiyama, 2026 , Li et al., 2026a , Wang et al., 2026a ] , while causal discovery and effect identifiability [ Li et al., 2025 , Li and Liu, 2025 , Li et al., 2026b ] , together with causal reasoning and failure tracing [ Lin⁢ et al., 2026b , Lin⁢ et al., 2026a , Zhu et al., 2026c ] , could inform investigations of hidden dependencies and error propagation across workers. This would require additional validation, since the current DAG represents execution dependencies rather than identified causal effects. Second, trustworthy execution and information management could be integrated into the scheduling objective. Relevant mechanisms include quality checks for unreliable feedback [ Cai et al., 2025 , Chen et al., 2026b , Huang et al., 2026e ] and misleading visual inputs [ Chen et al., 2026a ] , safeguards against unsafe execution [ Wu et al., 2026 ] and privacy leakage or unauthorized content reuse [ Xiang et al., 2026 , Huang et al., 2026b ] , and controls for knowledge retention [ Huang et al., 2026c ] and long-term memory attribution [ Zhang et al., 2026b ] . Their computational overhead should be included when deciding whether parallelization is worthwhile. Third, cross-domain evaluation could test whether these scheduling principles generalize to interaction and content generation, including dialogue and selling [ Gao et al., 2025 , Gao et al., 2024 , Su et al., 2026 ] and image and game generation [ Chen et al., 2025 , Huang et al., 2026a ] . Further evaluation could cover clinical and driving workflows [ Zhu et al., 2026a , Hu, 2026 , Zhu et al., 2025 , Zhu et al., 2026b , Huang et al., 2026f ] , as well as security analytics and delay-sensitive financial prediction [ Wang et al., 2026c , Ma et al., 2026 , You et al., 2026 ] . Such evaluations should examine latency, quality, and robustness jointly rather than assume that gains on the current tasks transfer directly.
paragraphs.zh: 未来的工作可以从三个方向扩展 SquidAgent。 首先，自适应调度和依赖建模可以在工作者能力和任务关系发生变化时改进决策。 在模型适应过程中可以重新校准成本估算 [ Huang et al., 2025 , Cai and Sugiyama, 2026 , Li et al., 2026a , Wang et al., 2026a ]，同时因果发现与效应可识别性 [ Li et al., 2025 , Li and Liu, 2025 , Li et al., 2026b ]，以及因果推理与故障追溯 [ Lin⁢ et al., 2026b , Lin⁢ et al., 2026a , Zhu et al., 2026c ]，可以为研究工作者之间的隐藏依赖和错误传播提供依据。 这将需要额外的验证，因为当前的 DAG 表示的是执行依赖关系，而非已识别的因果效应。 其次，可以将可信执行和信息管理整合到调度目标中。 相关机制包括对不可靠反馈的质量检查 [ Cai et al., 2025 , Chen et al., 2026b , Huang et al., 2026e ] 和对误导性视觉输入的处理 [ Chen et al., 2026a ]，防止不安全执行的保障措施 [ Wu et al., 2026 ]，以及防范隐私泄露或未经授权的内容重用 [ Xiang et al., 2026 , Huang et al., 2026b ]，还有知识保留控制 [ Huang et al., 2026c ] 和长期记忆归因控制 [ Zhang et al., 2026b ]。 在判断并行化是否值得时，应将它们的计算开销考虑在内。 第三，跨域评估可以检验这些调度原则是否能推广到交互和内容生成领域，包括对话和销售 [ Gao et al., 2025 , Gao et al., 2024 , Su et al., 2026 ]，以及图像和游戏生成 [ Chen et al., 2025 , Huang et al., 2026a ]。 进一步的评估可以涵盖临床和驾驶工作流程 [ Zhu et al., 2026a , Hu, 2026 , Zhu et al., 2025 , Zhu et al., 2026b , Huang et al., 2026f ]，以及安全分析和对延迟敏感的金融预测 [ Wang et al., 2026c , Ma et al., 2026 , You et al., 2026 ]。 此类评估应同时考察延迟、质量和鲁棒性，而不是假设当前任务上的改进能直接迁移到其他任务中。

paragraphs.en: Each task has a task-specific rubric organized into three tiers:
paragraphs.zh: 每个任务都有一个专门的任务评分标准，分为三个层级：

paragraphs.en: Tier 1 — Task Compliance (Hard Gate): Each item maps directly to a requirement in the benchmark prompt. If any Tier 1 item is NO, the output is marked “not acceptable.” Items include required files, features, algorithms, and a deliverability check (correct file structure, runs/renders without errors).
paragraphs.zh: 第一层级 — 任务合规性（硬性标准）：每个项目都直接对应基准提示中的一个要求。 如果任何第一层级项目为“否”，则输出将被标记为“不可接受”。这些项目包括必需的文件、功能、算法以及交付性检查（正确的文件结构，能够无错误地运行/渲染）。
